allhallowmas.definition: n. The feast of All Saints.
allhallowmas.translation: n. 万圣节, 万圣节宴

allhallows.definition: n a Christian feast day honoring all the saints; first observed in 835
allhallows.translation: n. 诸圣日(每年11月1日,亦称为“万圣节”)

allhallowtide.definition: n the season of All Saints' Day
allhallowtide.translation: [古]万圣节期间或快到万圣节的时候

allheal.definition:
n. A name popularly given to the officinal valerian, and to
   some other plants.
allheal.translation: n. 万灵草药(指缬草、夏枯草等)
